messages:
maria: Quick kickoff — we need a tight SEO play for the content launch + webinar funnel. Primary goals: benchmark narrative visibility, inbound lead routing, and reduce redirect churn. Who can own the keyword clusters and the redirect map?

sam: I can take keyword clusters. will upload a seed sheet by EOD. thinking 3 priority clusters: product-led, inference-cost, latency optimizations.

jake: I’ll own schema & structured data for the launch pages + webinar landing. plan: FAQ, Event, and Speakership ld+json. will also add CTAs for lead routing events.

olivia: I’ll do internal linking + canonical review across the hub. need a short list of pillar pages from Sam. also propose a redirect sweep on launch day — canonical fallback policy for old paths.

maria: Nice. timeline: seed KW sheet today, schema draft tomorrow, internal links + redirect list by Thurs. we want a preflight checklist 24h before publish. who can pull a redirect smoke test? @seo-ci-bot can run a test suite but need the mapping.

seo-ci-bot: CI check queued: run-redirect-scan v1. Please add CSV to /marketing/seo/redirects/launch-3001112223.csv to trigger.

sam: uploaded: https://drive.redwood.example/seo/kw-seed-3001112223.csv — includes search intent, CTAs, and two sample H2 suggestions per page.

jake: draft schema snippet for webinar landing: ```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Inference Launch: Benchmarking Inference","startDate":"2024-05-14T16:00:00Z","performer":{"@type":"Person","name":"Maria Lopez"},"eventStatus":"https://schema.org/EventScheduled"}
```

olivia: Internal link rules proposal: 1) link pillar -> cluster -> resource (no orphaned cluster pages), 2) max 3 deep clicks from homepage, 3) add jump links in long benchmark narratives. also add rel=canonical headers for syndicated posts.

maria: For redirects: prefer 301 for permanent path changes, 302 only for temporary campaign links. If we retire old blog posts, map to closest pillar, not homepage unless no match. add edge-case rule: if >5 broken backlinks, open inbound-routing ticket to sales ops.

sam: small note — prioritize KW with clear demo intent for webinar CTAs (e.g., "inference cost calculator demo"), will tag those in the sheet as DEMO.

jake: QA checklist for schema: 1) JSON-LD validates in Rich Results test, 2) Event markup includes startDate & organizer, 3) no duplicate IDs across pages.

olivia: redirect sweep plan (short): export current redirect table, diff against proposed CSV, flag collisions, prepare revert plan. I’ll run a smoke test on staging with curl: `curl -I https://redwood.ai/old-path -L` and validate 200 on final destination.

maria: Assignments: Sam = KW clusters + CTAs, Jake = schema + JSON-LD, Olivia = internal linking + redirect sweep, Maria = benchmark narrative + launch comms. Target ship window: publish + webinar in 10 business days.

sam: :thumbsup: will also add KW mapping to content briefs (meta title + meta description suggestions).

jake: will push schema drafts to the docs repo and add a sample include partial for the NextJS landing.

olivia: will post redirect CSV in the shared drive and notify eng on rollout channel once smoke passes.

maria: Preflight checklist (short): 1) KW sheet locked, 2) schema validated, 3) internal links implemented, 4) redirect CSV reviewed + tested, 5) tracking pixels + lead routing confirmed. please mark done in the sheet.

seo-ci-bot: Preflight checklist status: 0/5. Waiting for uploaded artifacts.

maria: Ok team — small, focused sprint. update this thread as you make progress. tagging for heads-up: @sam @jake @olivia.
